sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Boreas crew quarters keycard (CQ) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A Paradigm Shipping keycard granting access to the crew cabins aboard the Boreas icebreaker.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: In one of five locations on level 3 of Icebreaker. A single keycard is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Locations
sections.text: Doors to multiple crew rooms on Icebreaker.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
